correctness.rationale: The exact two-by-two inverse yields the hyperbolic-sine cardinal formula. A uniform tail estimate makes the compact scaled-profile limit globally valid. Its two strict maximizers imply localization. A smooth even-h Taylor expansion near each maximizer proves strict concavity and unique extrema, with G_p(t)=1+2t²/3+(p-1)/(2t²), G_p(1/√2)=p+1/3 and critical displacement √2(2/3-p/2)h². Raising the exact maximal norm to the p-th power supplies the stated sharp coefficient. The embedded numerical checker verifies 16272 finite assertions but is not a proof.

value.rationale: Wang–Song–Zhang identify Λ_p exactly as the minimal powered regularization comparison factor; the theorem determines its sharp h^-p degradation under a natural two-node Gaussian collision, including the second-order p-dependent worst-evaluation-location effect.
